name: Just Tell Us What's Going On
source:
You've sat your parents down, and you're finally going to tell them that you're a transgender girl. Here's to hoping it all goes off without a hitch!

This game was made over the course of a month for NaNoRenO 2018!
translation:
你让父母坐下，终于准备告诉他们，自己是一名跨性别女孩。希望一切都能顺顺利利！

本作在一个月内制作完成，参加了NaNoRenO 2018！
